name: Agamaggan's Blood
summary: Kog'thug the Brave wants a particular blood sample from Razorfen Downs. The blood he seeks is distinct from the kind found in Razorfen Kraul.

sections.title: A Different Sample
sections.body: At Bristleback Retreat in Desolace, Kog'thug the Brave asks you to bring him Virulent Blood of Agamaggan from Razorfen Downs. The blood in Razorfen Kraul will not do; he needs the sample from the Downs.

faq.answer: Kog'thug the Brave asks you to obtain Virulent Blood of Agamaggan from Razorfen Downs.

faq.q: Where do I find the blood?
faq.answer: The requested Virulent Blood of Agamaggan is in Razorfen Downs.

faq.q: Will the blood from Razorfen Kraul work?
faq.answer: No. Kog'thug says the Blood of Agamaggan in Razorfen Kraul is not sufficient.

faq.q: Who is asking for the blood?
faq.answer: Kog'thug the Brave at Bristleback Retreat in Desolace asks for the blood.
